An '''Asteroid Fortress''' was a class of [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] defense weapon. Eight of them were deployed in the [[Kalinda system/Legends|Kalinda system]] and engaged [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces during the [[Battle of Kalinda]].
